title: Firearm Vol. 1 #12 Aug 1994 The Rafferty Saga Begins! Malibu Comics ULTRAVERSE
descriptionText: The product is a comic book from August 1994, specifically issue number 12 in the Ultraverse series published by Malibu Comics. The main character of the series is Firearm, marking the beginning of The Rafferty Saga. This comic belongs to the US Comics tradition and is a valuable collectible for fans of comic books and graphic novels.
